name: Meeting Event Reference 1 Choice
definition: Choice between a meeting event identification or a meeting event official identification.

LinkedIssuerMeetingIdentification.name: Linked Issuer Meeting Identification
LinkedIssuerMeetingIdentification.definition: Official and unique reference assigned by the official central body/ entity within each market at the beginning of a meeting event.

LinkedMeetingIdentification.name: Linked Meeting Identification
LinkedMeetingIdentification.definition: Reference assigned by the account servicer to unambiguously identify a related meeting event.
